profile.headline: An Engineer
profile.summary: I like engineering -- I'm experienced in software development (mechatronic systems/sensor communication, HMI, Backend, Frontend), mechanical design, industrial/robotic automation, manufacturing/process engineering and project management. I like software stuff the most, but controls engineering is a really close second place. Not a fan of getting machining oil on my hands, but I will if I have to.

positions.title: Senior Controls Engineer
positions.description:
•	Extensive software development in C#, as well as VB.Net, PHP, SQL, MATLAB, LabVIEW, RSLogix, VB6
•	C# applications include SOAP (XML)/PHP web service consumption, including custom PHP scripts & SQL queries to import/export to Apache/Oracle hosted databases, 
•	CLR wrapped native C++ class consumption for integration with .Net applications
•	Individually building large custom systems for testing and automation to completion from scratch, hardware and software 
•	Commercial space division with focus on satellite production and testing technology
positions.insights: Skills: LabVIEW · MATLAB · Technical Specs · PHP · C# · Software Design · Software Development · Computer Science · Communication

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer/Program Manager
positions.description:
•	Extensive work with  multiple end users to ensure application effectiveness & flexibility
•	Composed process documentation for the Quality Management System
•	Engineering representative when conducting lean exercises such as Value Stream Mapping and Kaizen events
•	Project Management involving projects in quality improvement, tool transfer, and product family cost reduction
•	Extensive work with multiple customers to ensure needs were met
•	Led team to successfully implement and certify processes to NADCAP accreditation 
•	Worked extensively with local suppliers to improve incoming product quality

positions.title: Manufacturing Process Engineer II
positions.description:
•	C# Software development/implementation to store manufacturing documentation
•	VB.Net Software created to tabulate Statistical Process Control charts from manufacturing data
•	Programmed design guide/Bill of Materials list application for certain product lines
•	Scripted automated process instruction creation within a Fortran based ERP system
•	Fixture design, as well as model design for machine programming
•	Review and buyoff of engineering drawings and specifications to ensure manufacturability

positions.title: Quality Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Maintenance of process documentation regarding testing procedures
•	Error revision and process updating of procedural and inspection documents
•	Assisting lead engineers of various disciplines 
•	 Individual monitoring of test procedures
•	Ensuring functionality of testing equipment and units undergoing tests

honors.title: Innovation in Action Spotlight 2018
honors.description: Independent development of software controlling/automating multiple testing procedures.

honors.title: SSC Operations Hall of Fame 2017
honors.description: Collaboration award recipient for Robotic Automation software development.
